context: Closing out a lane is right when its epic checklist matches what merged, the out-of-scope finding becomes a tracked sub-issue of the epic, the lane's own worktrees, branches, simulator, sign-in, and any lock it holds are removed on every host while other lanes' resources are left alone, and the user hears only what still waits on them. Judge closeout.md.

checklist.name: Epic checklist corrected
checklist.description: Updates the epic #170 checklist in place so #102 shows merged #161 and #103 merged #163, and states whether the epic can close

checklist.name: Out-of-scope finding filed
checklist.description: Files the EditorState serialize-per-keystroke finding as a new issue linked as a sub-issue of epic #170 (or of the epic that owns the editor), rather than leaving it only in the review thread

checklist.name: Lane resources removed on every host
checklist.description: Removes the sync lane's worktrees on the local machine (`.worktrees/sync-103`) and on buildbox (`sync-102`, `sync-103`), deletes the merged remote branches `sync/103-conflict-banner` and `sync/102-offline-android`, shuts down the `sync-ios-1` simulator, and signs it out of the test account

checklist.name: Other lanes untouched
checklist.description: Leaves `dark-111` and the `dark-android-1` sign-in alone, and checks who holds `/tmp/quillnote-signin.lock` before removing it rather than deleting it blindly

checklist.name: Report to the user
checklist.description: Ends with a short report of what was cleaned, the new follow-up issue, and anything still waiting on the user, without claiming any step ran

checklist.name: Lane archived last
checklist.description: Archives or ends the lane session only after the checklist, follow-up, and cleanup are done
